Cube Pets 2.0
Creator: Kenney (https://www.kenney.nl)
Source package: Kenney Cube Pets
License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The models may be used for personal, educational, and commercial purposes.
Credit is not required by the license; it is included here to identify the source.

Game integration converts the original GLB meshes and shared color map to a
compact vertex-colored runtime pack. The supplied Kenney preview renders are
used as the animal selection thumbnails.
